LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryPaused: Refuelling paused: fuel recovery needs review.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryChanged: A recorded item has changed or is no longer available.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryCustodyUnknown: Where the remaining material is held could not be confirmed.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryRecordMissing: Refuelling is paused. The interruption happened before its details could be fully saved. The amounts of fuel added and material consumed cannot be confirmed.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryReviewDesc: Review interrupted refuelling and choose what to do with the remaining material. These actions do not add fuel again.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryAccept: Keep the current state and resume
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoverySyncUnavailable: unavailable: this action could not be set up for multiplayer
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryPayConfirm: Consume the exact recorded material for fuel already added? No fuel will be added again. An earlier attempt may already have triggered other effects, even if it reported an error. This action tries once and does not repeat automatically.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryRestoreConfirm: Try once to return the recorded material to this pawn's inventory? Unchanged items in saved recovery custody can be moved without adding fuel or consuming material. This does not settle any recorded fuel debt or uncertainty; review and resolution remain separate. Unowned items can be returned only when no fuel was observed being added. Keep and loadout settings stay as they are.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryCleanupConfirm: Recheck the remaining inventory after the recorded material was consumed? This does not add fuel, destroy more items or restore old keep or loadout settings.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryAcceptConfirm: Keep current items and fuel levels as they are and allow new Hauler's Dream refuelling jobs? The interrupted action will not be repeated, and its details will remain saved. Any uncertain amounts of fuel or material remain unverified. Resuming does not correct them.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoverySelectionChanged: The recovery or its items changed. Open the recovery menu again before choosing an action.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryPaidOutcome: Last fuel recovery: the recorded material was consumed and inventory tracking was updated.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryUncreditedOutcome: Last fuel recovery: no fuel was observed being added, and the remaining material is accounted for.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryUncertainOutcome: Last fuel recovery: refuelling was resumed with the current items and fuel levels. The earlier amounts of fuel added and material consumed remain unverified.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryCostPaid: The recorded material cost was confirmed as consumed. Review the current state before resuming refuelling.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryRestored: The recovery action finished. Review the current state before resuming refuelling.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryNoCredit: No fuel was observed being added during the interrupted action.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryKnownDebt: Fuel was added, but its recorded material cost was not confirmed as consumed.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryUncertain: The amounts of fuel added or material consumed are uncertain. The current fuel level cannot establish what happened.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryPriorDestroy: An earlier attempt to consume the material was made. Any effects it triggered may already have occurred, even if it reported an error.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryNoExactCost: The exact recorded material cannot be consumed by this action. It will not guess which pieces to consume, split a changed remainder or consume a replacement item.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryNoOwner: Not currently held anywhere or placed on a map.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryLastActionFailed: An earlier recovery action reported an error. Its details remain saved.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryInRetainedCustody: Held in saved fuel recovery custody for this pawn.
LanguageData.HD_RefuelRecoveryRetainedBeforeResume: Return the retained material to inventory, or consume its exact confirmed fuel cost, before resuming. Returning material changes only where it is held; any fuel debt or uncertainty remains unresolved.
